highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: Concordia University, St. Paul, provides both on-campus and off-campus housing choices. For those seeking the convenience of living with like-minded peers on campus, two residence halls are housing 100 first-year students: Wollaeger Hall and Luther Hall, and residence halls for those in further years. Hyatt Village is a living-learning community that houses a mixture of men and women and is connected to the main campus tunnel, where students have the fitness and shared kitchen area.
